world.org_type: community health center network (a federally qualified health center with twelve primary care clinics)

driver: The decisive quantity is a classifier's hit rate on the positive class at each of several sites and each of a few decision thresholds, known only from a validation batch read against a reference standard; the batch's items were captured on two kinds of device whose hit rates differ widely at every threshold, in a mix that leaves every site's and every recorded subgroup's rate near the pooled one, and the device behind each item is in no column, recovered only by placing each item's site and date in a dated register of where each device stood, so each site's threshold is set on hit rates carried device by device at the share of its own items each device captured, not pooled, not site by site and not by any recorded subgroup.
driver_concrete: Each clinic's 2027 operating point is the least sensitive of the vendor's points at which the AI's sensitivity for referable diabetic retinopathy among the clinic's reference-year screenings reaches 85 per cent, that sensitivity being the local validation study's sensitivity on each retinal camera model at the point (the model behind each validation image recovered by placing its clinic and capture date in the biomedical engineering register's placements) weighted by the share of the clinic's screenings each model captured; pooled, pilot by pilot or reweighted to any recorded subgroup, the standard point clears 85 per cent everywhere.
stump: A competent analyst carries the local validation study's sensitivity at each operating point to every clinic, pooled, pilot by pilot or reweighted to each clinic's patient mix, and sets all twelve clinics at the vendor's standard point; the study's images came from two camera models whose sensitivities differ by about thirty points at that point in a mix that hides it, and only each model's sensitivity, the model behind each image recovered from the camera register's placement dates and carried by each clinic's own camera mix, moves five clinics to more sensitive points.

differentiation.task181: task181 v6 lays a shared upstream resource's excess outcome risk on the units it served and removes it case by case; task281 removes nothing from any unit: it carries a classifier's hit rate measured on a validation batch to each site by the capture device behind each item, recovered through a dated placement register, because the sites ran the devices in different proportions.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of each group's surviving units that will suffer one wear-out failure before a fixed age, read past a record whose follow-up ends early in the wear-out, when part of the units carry a part from a source that never wears out that way; the record is too young to show the plateau, so one lifetime fit on every unit passes its back-test and treats those units' zeros as failures still to come, and only a provenance record kept for warranty claims, joined unit by unit through the delivery lot, shows which units are at risk at all.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each conversion phase's share of luminaires still on their original driver on 1 January 2027 whose driver will fail before the luminaire's twelfth year comes from a Weibull fitted only to the drivers of the maker whose drivers wear out; the other maker's drivers, identified only through the installer's lot numbers and the manufacturer's certificates of conformance, show no wear-out, so one fit over every luminaire reads their zeros as failures still to come and puts every phase in the program.
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits the lifecycle model's Weibull with suspensions to every conversion driver and projects each phase's original-driver luminaires, filing all ten phases into the 2027 group driver replacement program at 68 to 71 per cent each; Corvane's drivers, found only through the installer's lot numbers and the luminaire maker's certificates of conformance, show no wear-out (16 failures against the 555 that fit expects), so the fit belongs to Vantrel's drivers alone and only P1, P3, P5, P7 and P9 clear 45 per cent.

lineage.stump: A competent solver executes the standard and rates a relief position at the title's average officer (32.4 to 35.3 hours on post a week), filing 63 positions, three short; the positions are filled from the July 2027 entry classes, and the July 2025 classes' first year (7.8 per cent off post against 14.5) puts a holder at 36.7 to 37.0 hours, so 59 are placed and one returns to the reserve.
